Add an exact place collection to an existing obis-h3 release

Source: R/place_exact.R
obis_h3_add_place_exact.Rd

obis_place_exact_write() puts place_exact/coll=<coll>/ into a release directory; this registers it the way obis_h3_export_parquet() does for a place_exact collection exported in the same run: release.json gets the layers$place_exact entry (the collection from its meta.json, plus the layer's rows, files and bytes over every collection on disk), and, with manifest = TRUE, files.parquet has its place_exact rows replaced by one row per file on disk and files$n_files in release.json is updated. The layer's template, columns and note are kept when release.json already has them, except that a collection with species.parquet adds the species template and columns to an entry written before 0.11.0. Nothing else in the release is touched (stats.parquet, the other layers' rows, collection.json), and running it again for the same coll gives the same entries.

Usage

obis_h3_add_place_exact(
  release_dir,
  coll,
  source = NULL,
  manifest = TRUE,
  compression = "zstd"
)

Arguments

release_dir

the release directory (holding release.json, files.parquet and place_exact/coll=<coll>/{indicators,years}.parquet, meta.json).

coll

the collection slug already written under place_exact/.

source

optional text recorded as the collection's source (where the polygons came from); default: the existing entry's, else omitted.

manifest

also update files.parquet (default TRUE).

compression

Parquet compression of the rewritten files.parquet.

Value

invisibly, the paths of the files rewritten (release.json, and files.parquet with manifest = TRUE).

Details

Use it to add a collection after a release was built (for example the gazetteer places sanctuaries, computed with data-raw/run_place_exact.R), on a staging copy of the release: release_dir must hold release.json, and files.parquet when manifest = TRUE, plus every collection the release already lists (a collection listed in release.json but missing on disk is kept in collections with a warning, and not counted in rows, files, bytes).
